description:
Compete in Axe Champ Shoot Out to reach the finish line first!
Smash all the targets and move back closer to the winning line!
Beat the competition to be the true Axe Champion!
Or try your skills in Solo Mode as you smash your way through the levels and take on the bosses.
name: Axe Champ Shoot Out
intro: Can you be the Axe Champ?
